run-boundary.ownership: README sections 2 and 6: each C owner retains its own state; broker owns world; evaluator owns post-run analysis.
run-boundary.authority: README sections 2 and 4: exact public mission grants only; model has no tool/operator authority; evaluator receives artifacts only after closure.
run-boundary.shape_versions: SOURCE_PINS and RUN_CONFIG: native source/public schemas retained; new intent/image/clock schemas proposed and block contract acceptance; exact processor/model versions required.
run-boundary.identity_scope: Run/session/workspace plus issuer/source/epoch/document/occurrence, exact selectors and hashes; duplicate payload is not duplicate occurrence.
run-boundary.time_order: README clock contract: simulation year, source time, receipt, commit and knowledge cut distinct; inference takes a pinned cut; offline transfer after closure.
run-boundary.delivery_idempotency: README restart contract: original stable request/body and operation replay; changed reuse conflicts; no assumed inference HTTP deduplication.
run-boundary.commit_recovery: README section 2: no distributed transaction; write-ahead intent, broker replay, C1 occurrence commit then C0 ack; unresolved workers require trusted reconciliation.
run-boundary.retention: Private durable run volumes and acquired bytes through analysis; no runtime garbage collection of supporting evidence; capacity yields. Secrets/databases excluded from Git.
run-boundary.resource_limits: RUN_CONFIG proposed root budgets and stricter owner/public page/chunk/job caps; all prompt/image/helper/failed work charged or unknown.
run-boundary.errors: Explicit denied/unsupported/unavailable/conflict/partial/capacity/timeout/uncertain completion; no semantic answer fabrication or silent fallback.
run-boundary.feedback_grounding: Public acquired records remain reports/simulation observations; model/teacher/derived/simulated output is not independent external evidence; no evaluator-to-runtime feedback.

feedback_reviews.analysis: EDI selects acquired evidence, model proposes next work, C0/C7 gates world changes, C1 records later results. Preserve complete return paths, delayed measures, chosen exposure, independent-source grouping and nonidentifiability; generated summaries/teacher agreement cannot corroborate. Broker state and EDI memory are separate authorities. Model failure yields bounded inquiry without blocking intake. No evaluator return edge. Replay must not duplicate physical/simulated effects or cost.
